evals.prompt: I designed an OC - a young female mage, red hooded cloak, silver staff with a blue gem, brown leather boots, dark hair in a braid. Can I get a breakdown sheet with turnaround and clothing layers?
evals.expected_output: Structured prompt with CHARACTER/BODY/FACE/HAIR/CLOTHING/ACCESSORIES/EQUIPMENT/TURNAROUND/BREAKDOWN(clothing layers)/PALETTE, no undressed depictions, plain-English layout note.

evals.prompt: Here's a front-view illustration of my character (imagine: a knight with full plate armor, visor down, cape). Generate a full breakdown sheet with turnaround including the back view.
evals.expected_output: Should flag armor-back and cape-back as inferred/ask a short clarifying question if a meaningful design detail (e.g. emblem) is uncertain, rather than inventing confident detail.

evals.prompt: Generate a breakdown for a character with very long flowing multi-layered hair, several hair accessories, and layered fantasy armor over a tunic.
evals.expected_output: Should include a dedicated hair breakdown and clothing-layer breakdown given complexity, per Step 2 judgment, not skip them.
